verdict.rationale: Community evidence, including what appears to be a Proton reply, points to public Proton Pass repositories on GitHub. Another commenter notes that only the clients appear to be open source. One user could not find the repo at launch, but the GitHub link supplied in the same thread answers that, so it is not a concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the open-source status and the specific license, any server-side source, and independent confirmation of the license terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
